subskill: Sine ratio and perimeter of a right triangle
prompt: Triangle PQR has a right angle at vertex R, so side PQ is the hypotenuse, side QR is opposite angle P, and side PR is adjacent to angle P. The value of sin P is 8/17, and the perimeter of triangle PQR is 120 centimeters. To the nearest centimeter, what is the length of side PR?
